page.overview:
Who is Berandis?

Berandis was a male Human Adumari who served as the assistant manager of the Challabae Admits-No-Equal Aerial Eruptive Manufacturing Concern, a missile manufacturing plant on the planet Adumar. Berandis was in charge of public concerns for the company. In 13 ABY, Berandis gave a tour of the company's plant to Red Flight—a group of New Republic veteran pilots—during their diplomatic mission to Adumar.

Berandis is a character created by author Aaron Allston for the 1999 novel X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar, the ninth novel in the X-Wing series.
